claude.sample_unit: online patient educational materials (57 English, 56 Spanish)

links.outcome: Reading grade level of orthopaedic patient materials before vs after ChatGPT rewrite to sixth-grade level
links.effect: English grade level fell from 9.6 ± 2.6 to 7.7 ± 1.9; Spanish from 9.5 ± 1.5 to 8.3 ± 1.3 (p < 0.05), but neither reached sixth grade.
links.quote: ChatGPT significantly lowered the reading grade level (improved comprehension) to 7.7 ± 1.9 (95% CI of difference, 1.68 to 2.15; p < 0.05) for English-language content and 8.3 ± 1.3 (95% CI, 1.17 to 1.45; p < 0.05) for Spanish-language content.

links.outcome: Readability, word count, complex words and long sentences of patient education materials after AI plain-language rewrite
links.effect: Grade level reduced 2.0 ± 1.8 (English) and 1.5 ± 1.2 (Spanish); word count, complex words, and long sentences significantly reduced while maintaining high accuracy and similarity.
links.quote: Word count, use of complex words, and long sentences were also reduced significantly in both languages while still maintaining high accuracy and similarity compared with original content.

links.outcome: Reading level after sixth-grade rewrite prompt
